description: This file defines the 'GenericGrainInterfaceType' struct, which represents a generic grain interface type in Orleans. It includes methods for parsing, constructing, and retrieving type arguments related to grain interfaces, emphasizing generic type handling within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: GenericGrainInterfaceType
classes.description: Immutable struct representing a parameterized grain interface type with methods for parsing, constructing, and retrieving type arguments.

methods.name: TryParse
methods.description: Attempts to parse a GrainInterfaceType into a GenericGrainInterfaceType, returning true if successful.

methods.name: GetGenericGrainType
methods.description: Returns a non-constructed version of the current generic grain interface type.

methods.name: Construct
methods.description: Constructs a specific generic grain interface type given type arguments.

methods.name: GetArguments
methods.description: Retrieves the type arguments with which this generic grain interface type was constructed.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the grain interface type.
